newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica govt set to approve Coega port -- minister.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica govt set to approve Coega port -- minister.

text.p: The South African government is almost certain to give its formal backing to a proposed new industrial port at Coega, near Port Elizabeth, trade and industry minister Alec Erwin said on Thursday.

"It is now virtually certain that we will proceed with the new industrial port at Coega, probably investing in that area in the region of 1.3 billion rand in the first stages," he told parliament's finance committee.

The planned new bulk harbour would be capable of taking vessels up to 80,000 deadweight tonnes and is planned as a gateway to a 10,000 hectare industrial development zone which would bring jobs to an area suffering from high unemployment.

Catalyst for the scheme is a planned 220,000 tonnes a year zinc smelter which Gencor Ltd is considering building and neighbouring fertiliser factory which would be constructed by AECI Ltd unit Kynoch.
Other potential backers include cement, steel and battery manufacturers.
